edenKeys.title: Missing Nintendo Switch files
edenKeys.message: Eden needs the keys and firmware to open Switch games.
edenKeys.legal: Keys and firmware are dumped from your own Switch; they cannot be downloaded nor ship with the app.
edenKeys.inUseDesc: Always configure in this Eden (“Open Eden” button). Games boot straight into fullscreen (-f -g) with no menus: changes made in another Eden or another user/ folder won't show up.
edenKeys.miiNote: Mii: only in Eden's GUI (not in-game) and needs firmware + a profile created in that same user/.

edenDlc.title: Updates & DLC (Switch)
edenDlc.subtitle: Install game updates and DLCs into Eden.
edenDlc.step1: 1. Press “Select files” and pick your update or DLC .nsp/.xci files.
edenDlc.step3: 3. In Eden: File → Install Files to NAND… and pick the staging files.
edenDlc.step4: 4. Press Install, wait for the success prompt, then come back and “Check again”.
edenDlc.mergedNote: “Merged” .nsp/.xci files (game + update in a single file) need none of this: they just work.

help.title: Streaming FAQ
help.faqRes: What resolution and refresh rate will I get?
help.faqResA: Up to 1080p or 4K at smooth 60 FPS with hardware decoding from your GPU.
help.faqWhyA: Moonlight and Sunshine use the world's fastest real-time streaming protocol, with under 15 ms of latency. Since it's portable, it lives inside the NewGamePlus folder and doesn't clutter your Windows install.
